name: Surfing Ocean
description: Reggae style surfboard on sandy beach

visual_style.dimension: DSLR camera photograph shot with Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/1.8 lens, natural bokeh background blur, shallow depth of field, professional photography
visual_style.texture: macro level detail, every sand grain individually visible, realistic weathered surfboard with peeling paint chips, authentic sun-bleached colors, visible wood grain texture with realistic imperfections, real scratches and dents on board surface
visual_style.detail_level: HYPER REALISTIC 8K RAW photograph, studio quality lighting, perfect exposure, natural color grading like Fujifilm film stock, absolutely no AI artifacts, must be indistinguishable from real photograph taken by professional photographer
visual_style.composition: National Geographic quality product photography, golden hour lighting (soft warm sunlight), surfboard at 45 degree angle on beach, photojournalism style, real camera perspective with slight lens distortion

dos: MUST BE INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM REAL CAMERA PHOTOGRAPH
Shot with professional DSLR camera - Canon EOS R5 or Nikon D850
Natural film grain like Kodak Portra 400
Golden hour soft lighting with long natural shadows
Show only surfboard on beach - absolutely no people
Reggae colors (red yellow green) painted on actual weathered surfboard
Macro detail - show every sand grain, scratches, paint chips
Real sun-faded colors and authentic beach weathering
Natural bokeh blur in background with f/1.8 aperture
Visible texture imperfections - worn paint, small dents, sun damage
Professional color grading like real beach photography
Natural lighting imperfections and lens flares
donts: ABSOLUTELY NO digital art or AI-generated look
NO cartoon, illustration, or painting style whatsoever
NO perfect symmetry or artificial placement
NO overly saturated or enhanced colors
NO people, surfers, or human elements
NO water action or ocean waves
NO harsh midday sunlight - only golden hour soft light
